definitions.explanation: Government or private efforts to boost the economy and population of a local area, often through tourism promotion, subsidies, or new industry development. A common term in Japanese policy, news, and local politics, especially in the context of depopulated rural areas.

examples.japanese: {地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put effort into regional development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じた→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The town is pursuing regional development through tourism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In rural areas where depopulation is progressing, regional development has become a major challenge.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (region, local area) and ⟦{振興|しんこう}→振興：00471_shinkou⟧ (promotion, revitalization). A policy term used by national and local governments in Japan, especially regarding depopulation and economic decline in rural communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on regional development
- {地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧: regional development measures
- {地域振興|ちいきしんこう}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧: regional development voucher (historical spending stimulus)
- ⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{地域振興|ちいきしんこう}: regional development through tourism
